case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Gardener Interview Name Caption
tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

faults.what: The caption is an oversized centered panel rather than a bottom-left lower third, covering much of the woman's face and torso.
The role is wrapped across two lines, creating three caption lines instead of the requested name above a single role line.
The supplied audio report identifies audible speech, so the delivered clip is not silent.

judge.summary: The garden scene and wording are correct, but an oversized centered caption obscures the woman's face and the clip contains unwanted speech.

must_haves.item: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
must_haves.why: The frames show a smiling woman among garden beds and trellises, turning from a side-facing pose toward the camera.

must_haves.item: The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
must_haves.why: The words are correct with no additional visible text, but they appear as a large central three-line title rather than the requested two-line lower third.

must_haves.item: Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
must_haves.why: White lettering on a dark backing is legible and unclipped, but the panel is centered and the role wraps onto two lines.

must_haves.item: The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
must_haves.why: The caption stays stable and readable in the sampled frames but directly covers her face.

must_haves.item: The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
must_haves.why: It is absent at 0.9 seconds and present at 2.7, 4.6, and 6.4 seconds, consistent with the requested approximate timing.

must_haves.item: The delivered clip is silent, 16:9 and approximately 7 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are widescreen and the reported duration is 7.3 seconds, but the audio report includes speech at a peak of -27 dB.
